title: Yellowfin Failures by Report
app: Yellowfin audit database via DB Connect and application logs via UF.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=yellowfin:audit status="Error"
| stats count as failures, latest(_time) as last_failure by report_name
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Counts Yellowfin failures grouped by report so operators immediately see which specific reports are broken rather than a single global failure number.
value: Object-level failure attribution turns a vague 'Yellowfin is failing' alert into an actionable list of exactly what to fix first.
implementation: Ingest Yellowfin failure events; schedule every 15 minutes and alert on failures for business-critical reports.
visualization: Table of report by failure count and last failure time.
grandmaExplanation: We tell you exactly which parts of Yellowfin are failing, not just that something is wrong, so the right thing gets fixed first.
